title: DECSET 1015 — URXVT mouse mode
summary: CSI ? 1015 h enables the urxvt mouse encoding: CSI Cb ; Cx ; Cy M with decimal coordinates (no +32 offset, no 223 limit). CSI ? 1015 l disables it. An alternative to 1006 (SGR) with a different format.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1015 h Mouse tracking; urxvt decimal encoding.

gotchas: URXVT format: CSI <Cb>;<Cx>;<Cy>M (decimal, no angle bracket, no press/release distinction in final byte).
Superseded by 1006 (SGR) which distinguishes press (M) from release (m).

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1015 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1015 h/l sequences.
